description:
No Man's Sky Remnant Update is out now on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/no-mans-sky-nintendo-switch-2-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1057-01&utm_id=P1057-01 

Upgrade your Multi-Tool and physically manipulate objects with the Gravitino Coil (gravity gun)! 

Magnetize, carry, and launch stacks of industrial waste—and transport your haul in your off-road Colossus.  

Deck out your vehicle with an array of new wheels, cabins and modules, earn rewards, salvage materials, join the community in a cross-country road trip, and more!

author: Nintendo of America
description:
A dark journey awaits you in Death Howl, out now on Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/death-howl-switch/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1021-01&utm_id=P1021-01 

In forgotten lands shrouded by myth, Ro is on the hunt to bring her son back from the dead. Guided by voices from another world, she must journey to the spirit realm and face a host of restless spirits. Build decks and master grid-based combat as you progress, but be careful—not all spirits are friendly.
